project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 7 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 12 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Frodsham qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST LAWRENCE and Frodsham Water Sports Centre. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Frodsham: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Frodsham offers CHURCH OF ST LAWRENCE, Frodsham Water Sports Centre, FRODSHAM BRIDGE within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST LAWRENCE
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST LAWRENCE and Frodsham Water Sports Centre, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
